items.title: Route-scoped top-bar action lifecycle is deterministic
items.precondition: The isolated Vite server is running from the responsive-shell-foundation worktree.
steps: 1. Open the QA-only responsive-shell action fixture.
2. Exercise Strict Mode registration, descriptor updates, badge bounds, duplicate replacement, stale cleanup, route changes, and missing-provider handling.
3. Remove the focused action without navigating and inspect the resulting focus target.
items.expected: Exactly one current action renders; stale registrations cannot clear or revive another action; badge and callback updates preserve ownership; same-route removal restores focus to main.
items.evidence: npm run qa:shell passed all 170 focused checks, including every action-contract case.

items.title: Responsive top-bar hierarchy and touch targets hold across the matrix
items.precondition: The admin fixture is authenticated and extra-large text is active.
steps: 1. Verify the action fixture at 320x568 with navigation, long title, route action, and notifications.
2. Verify the authenticated shell at 320, 360, 390, 430, 640, 768, 960, 1024, 1280, 1440, 1680, and 2000 CSS-pixel widths.
3. Inspect horizontal overflow and control rectangles.
items.expected: There is no document-level horizontal clipping and primary shell controls remain at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
items.evidence: npm run qa:shell passed all 170 checks, including the full viewport matrix with 0px horizontal overflow and 44x44 navigation, action, and notification targets.

items.title: Safe-area and viewport-height geometry is consumed once
items.precondition: The authenticated shell is open at 390x844.
steps: 1. Override all four shell safe-area variables with deterministic non-zero values.
2. Measure the shell frame, top bar, main content, skip link, and open mobile navigation.
3. Shrink the viewport height while the mobile navigation remains open.
items.expected: The shell frame consumes all four values once; the skip link and portaled navigation respect their owned boundaries; route and footer state remain reachable after height change.
items.evidence: The 170-check qa:shell run measured frame padding 13/19/23/17px, correct top-bar/main boundaries, skip-link offsets 25/29px, and an inset mobile sheet that remained reachable after shrinking to 390x568.

items.title: Authenticated routes and desktop rail behavior remain healthy
items.precondition: The local app uses deterministic demo accounts and the worktree-only server.
steps: 1. Sweep every authenticated route at 320x568 using the authorized admin account.
2. Verify collapsed and expanded desktop rail persistence across constrained and 2000px widths.
3. Run the existing role-and-route smoke from a temporary Linux-configured copy.
items.expected: Routes render without shell overflow or uncaught errors, and the existing desktop rail storage contract remains unchanged.
items.evidence: npm run qa:shell passed the route and rail checks; the temporary path-only Linux adaptation of qa/smoke passed all 59 existing role/route checks.
items.notes: The repository npm run qa:smoke command itself cannot launch here because qa/smoke.mjs hardcodes /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome. The tracked suite was not modified.

items.title: Repository static and build gates pass
items.precondition: Dependencies are installed inside the dedicated linked worktree.
steps: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json.
2. Run npm run lint, npm run build, and npm run validate:mock.
3. Run static feature-import, persistence, safe-variable, and whitespace checks.
items.expected: All changed source typechecks, lints without errors, builds, preserves mock invariants, and introduces no feature coupling or persisted action state.
items.evidence: Typecheck, lint, build, validate:mock, node syntax, git diff --check, feature-import search, and action-persistence search passed. Lint retains warnings but exits 0.
items.notes: The repository has no check:all or check:conventions script. npm install reported the baseline Node 20 versus Puppeteer Node 22 engine warning and two existing high-severity audit findings; package-lock.json did not change.

items.title: Existing accessibility regression reaches its baseline Map fixture
items.precondition: The worktree server is running and no Google Maps key is required for the shell-focused path.
steps: 1. Run npm run qa:accessibility against the isolated server.
2. Verify pre-auth typography, form semantics, preference persistence, and route focus checks before the Map fixture.
3. Record the first unresolved baseline failure without changing the read-only regression suite.
items.expected: The suite completes, or its baseline fixture prerequisite is restored by the owning feature before finalization.
items.evidence: After copying the latest root .env and restarting the worktree server, the suite again passed its first 12 checks, then timed out waiting for [data-lot-list-action=true]. npm run validate:mock still reports 0 lots, so no list action can exist. This branch did not modify Map, mock data, or the accessibility suite.
items.notes: This is a baseline fixture prerequisite, not a responsive-shell regression. The owning Map or data refinement should restore deterministic lot coverage.
items.waiver: Explicitly accepted by the user on 2026-08-03: waive the zero-lot accessibility fixture because the deterministic baseline contains no lot-list action.

items.title: Manual zoom, assistive technology, and device-safe-area checks
items.precondition: A reviewer can use a desktop browser at actual 200% zoom plus a notched-device simulator or device.
steps: 1. At actual 200% browser zoom, verify 320-effective-width and representative desktop top bars with keyboard-only operation.
2. Inspect the route title and route-action names with an accessibility tree or screen reader, with and without a positive badge.
3. Verify portrait/landscape safe areas, an actual soft keyboard, focus return, and reduced-motion system and in-app preferences.
items.expected: No clipping, hidden primary control, focus loss, double inset, unreachable mobile-navigation region, or motion-dependent state occurs.
items.evidence: Automated checks cover extra-large text, 320px layout, keyboard focus restoration, deterministic safe-area overrides, viewport-height shrink, and reduced-motion preference setup. Real zoom, assistive technology, notch, and soft-keyboard checks were not run.
items.notes: The deferred manual checks remain recommended for downstream route and device acceptance.
items.waiver: Explicitly accepted by the user on 2026-08-03: waive the outstanding manual 200% zoom, assistive-technology, notched-device, and soft-keyboard checks for this branch.

items.title: Compact navigation remains above every route-owned surface
items.precondition: The responsive-shell worktree server is open at 390x844 with an admin session, Map presentation active, and Dashboard state docked.
steps: 1. Navigate to /map and confirm the docked Dashboard content is visible.
2. Activate the top-bar Open navigation hamburger.
3. Inspect the open sheet, backdrop, Dashboard slot, focus target, and document.elementFromPoint(24, 100).
4. Repeat after the shell-owned layer correction for hidden, docked, and full Dashboard states plus the reserved route-layer ceiling fixture.
items.expected: The mobile-navigation backdrop and content paint above route chrome, receive pointer input, contain focus, dismiss correctly, and preserve Dashboard and Map state.
items.evidence: npm run qa:shell passed all 170 checks. At 320x568 and 390x844, content/backdrop compute to 1010/1000 above the z-999 fixture and z-630 Dashboard; inside/outside hit tests resolve to sheet/backdrop. Map/list plus hidden/docked/full Dashboard states, Tab trapping, scroll lock, Escape/backdrop/close/navigation dismissal, focus restoration, single route transition, and persisted state preservation all passed. The current lot-detail layer is statically confirmed at 650.
items.notes: The correction is limited to shell-owned globals.css and focused QA. Map, Dashboard, lot detail, persisted panel state, and the global Sheet primitive were not modified.
